analysi.title: Investor Readiness Gap Analysis

structural_gaps.description: Need standardized board-grade narrative for DE/UK VC review.
structural_gaps.missing: Unified memo format with legal-financial tone

structural_gaps.description: Investor artifacts need repeatable publish workflow.
Service-health context should be attached to investor narratives.
structural_gaps.missing: Excel Core and Ocean Core runtime snapshot

risks.description: Inconsistent investor materials can reduce confidence and slow cycle time.
Without a publishing workflow, version control of investor documents can fragment.

implications: Lower conversion from investor meetings to data-room progression.
Higher review friction for institutional investors.
Reduced comparability across updated financial versions.

propagation_timeline.description: Lower close-rate without standardized board packet.

proposi.title: Board-Grade Investor Package Protocol
proposi.paradigm_description: A repeatable investor-document pipeline combining financial model integrity (Excel Core), platform intelligence context (Ocean Core), and publisher-governed distribution.
principles: Financial consistency across all investor-facing assets
Operational transparency with live service context

executive_summary: Clisonix operates a live, globally used platform and now standardizes investor communication through a board-grade protocol that links financial evidence (Excel Core), runtime context (Ocean Core), and publisher-governed artifact distribution.
